fields.label: Icon
fields.help: Choose the icon to display in the card (e.g. map marker, phone, envelope).

fields.label: Icon Color
fields.help: Select the color for the icon glyph.

fields.label: Card Heading
fields.help: Enter the main heading of the contact card (e.g. Address, Call Us).

fields.label: Card Text Content
fields.help: Enter the details like address text, email addresses, phone numbers, or hours.

fields.label: Background Color
fields.help: Select the background color of the contact card box.

fields.label: Border Width (px)
fields.help: Adjust the outline border width of the card card container.

fields.label: Border Radius (px)
fields.help: Adjust the roundness of the contact card corners.

fields.label: Icon Background Color
fields.help: Select the background color for the circular icon container.

fields.label: Icon Size (px)
fields.help: Adjust the size of the icon inside the circular container.

fields.label: Padding (px)
fields.help: Adjust the spacing inside the card boundary.
